# 3GPP Network
> Independent technical resource covering 3GPP mobile network architecture, protocols, procedures, and telecom engineering topics.

The site provides educational articles on LTE, 5G, IMS, signaling, interfaces, and core network concepts, aimed at telecom engineers, students, and practitioners seeking practical explanations of 3GPP-related technologies.

## Core Network Technologies
- [LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/p/lte.html): Overview page for LTE architecture, procedures, and related technical articles.
- [5G](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/p/5g.html): Central hub for 5G network architecture, interfaces, and protocol topics.
- [IMS](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/p/ims.html): Index of IMS architecture, SIP signaling, and service-related articles.
- [UMTS](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/p/umts.html): Collection of UMTS and legacy 3G network technology resources.
- [GSM](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/p/gsm.html): Introductory and reference material for GSM network concepts and procedures.

## LTE Architecture and Procedures
- [LTE Network Architecture](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-network-architecture.html): Explains LTE network elements, EPC components, and interface relationships.
- [LTE Attach Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-attach-procedure.html): Describes signaling flow and steps during UE attach in LTE.
- [LTE Tracking Area Update Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-tracking-area-update-procedure.html): Covers TAU signaling and mobility management behavior in LTE.
- [LTE Handover Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-handover-procedure.html): Summarizes LTE handover signaling and mobility control between cells.
- [LTE Bearers](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-bearers.html): Introduces default and dedicated bearers and QoS handling in LTE.
- [VoLTE Call Flow](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/volte-call-flow.html): Presents VoLTE signaling flow across LTE and IMS domains.

## 5G Architecture and Procedures
- [5G Network Architecture](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-network-architecture.html): Overview of 5G core functions, RAN, and service-based architecture.
- [5G Registration Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-registration-procedure.html): Explains UE registration signaling in the 5G core network.
- [5G PDU Session Establishment Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-pdu-session-establishment-procedure.html): Describes session setup signaling and involved 5G core functions.
- [5G Handover Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-handover-procedure.html): Covers mobility and handover signaling in 5G networks.
- [5G Network Functions](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-network-functions.html): Introduces AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, and other core functions.
- [5G Interfaces](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-interfaces.html): Summarizes major 5G interfaces and service-based interactions.

## IMS and VoLTE
- [IMS Architecture](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/ims-architecture.html): Describes IMS functional entities, roles, and signaling relationships.
- [SIP Call Flow](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/sip-call-flow.html): Explains SIP message exchange for session establishment and release.
- [VoLTE Architecture](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/volte-architecture.html): Overview of VoLTE service architecture across LTE and IMS.
- [VoWiFi Call Flow](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/vowifi-call-flow.html): Covers Wi-Fi calling signaling and IMS integration concepts.
- [PCRF in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/pcrf-in-lte.html): Explains policy control and charging rules in LTE networks.

## Interfaces and Protocols
- [S1 Interface in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/s1-interface-in-lte.html): Introduces S1-MME and S1-U roles in LTE architecture.
- [X2 Interface in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/x2-interface-in-lte.html): Describes X2 signaling and data forwarding between eNodeBs.
- [S5 and S8 Interfaces](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/s5-and-s8-interfaces.html): Explains EPC user plane and control plane connectivity.
- [Diameter Protocol in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/diameter-protocol-in-lte.html): Overview of Diameter usage in LTE core signaling.
- [GTP Protocol in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/gtp-protocol-in-lte.html): Describes GTP-C and GTP-U roles in mobile core networks.
- [SIP Protocol in IMS](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/sip-protocol-in-ims.html): Summarizes SIP protocol usage within IMS signaling procedures.

## Network Elements
- [MME in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/mme-in-lte.html): Explains MME responsibilities in mobility and session management.
- [SGW in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/sgw-in-lte.html): Describes Serving Gateway functions in LTE user plane handling.
- [PGW in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/pgw-in-lte.html): Covers PDN Gateway roles for connectivity, policy, and charging.
- [HSS in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/hss-in-lte.html): Introduces subscriber data management and authentication functions.
- [eNodeB in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/enodeb-in-lte.html): Explains eNodeB radio access and control responsibilities.
- [AMF in 5G](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/amf-in-5g.html): Describes AMF functions in access and mobility management.
- [SMF in 5G](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/smf-in-5g.html): Explains SMF responsibilities for session management in 5G.
- [UPF in 5G](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/upf-in-5g.html): Covers UPF packet forwarding and user plane processing roles.

## Mobility and Session Management
- [EPS Bearer Establishment Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/eps-bearer-establishment-procedure.html): Details bearer setup signaling and QoS assignment in LTE.
- [LTE Service Request Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-service-request-procedure.html): Explains UE service resumption and signaling in idle mobility.
- [LTE Detach Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/lte-detach-procedure.html): Describes network and UE initiated detach signaling steps.
- [Authentication Procedure in LTE](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/authentication-procedure-in-lte.html): Covers subscriber authentication and security establishment in LTE.
- [5G Authentication Procedure](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-authentication-procedure.html): Introduces authentication flow and security context creation in 5G.
- [5G Security](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/2018/01/5g-security.html): Summarizes security architecture and protection mechanisms in 5G.

## Site Navigation
- [Home](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/): Main landing page with recent telecom technology articles.
- [Search](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/search): Site search for finding articles by topic or keyword.
- [Labels](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/search/label/LTE): Label-based archive for LTE-related posts and references.
- [Labels: 5G](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/search/label/5G): Label archive for 5G articles and technical explainers.
- [Labels: IMS](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/search/label/IMS): Label archive for IMS and SIP signaling content.
- [Archive](https://www.3gppnetwork.org/p/archive.html): Chronological archive of published technical articles.
